The total area of the new wing is approximately 2,000 square meters. Downtime must be minimized, as any network failure could halt production, leading to significant financial losses. Key Requirements for the New Network Segment: High Reliability and Redundancy: The network must have built-in redundancy to prevent single points of failure, ensuring 24/7 continuous operation for the production lines. Quality of Service (QoS): Real-time data from machinery sensors and control systems (Operational Technology or OT) must be prioritized over standard IT traffic to prevent latency that could affect automation. Security Segmentation (OT/IT): The highly sensitive production equipment network (OT) must be strictly isolated from the standard corporate IT network (office PCs, emails, etc.) to prevent cyberattacks from moving laterally. Environmental Considerations: The network infrastructure (cables, access points) must be ruggedized to withstand the harsh manufacturing environment (dust, temperature fluctuations, and electromagnetic interference). Future IoT Integration: The design must easily accommodate the future addition of thousands of new industrial IoT (IIoT) sensors for predictive maintenance and energy management. Questions Based on the Scenario: i. What network architecture/topology would you recommend for the new wing? Justify your choice, specifically addressing the requirement for high reliability.
